notes.title: Thank you for the love and positivity!
notes.content: [h2]Cat Apocalypse is a story about finding true love! It is aimed to attract men who like pretty women, but to our surprise, pretty women with cats end up playing the game as well![/h2][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45003464/59fc74a9e02f9c7df937d0c66d03200670c3bc5e.png"][/img][/p][h2]We also saw veteran gamers having problems defeating the final boss fights, so we reduced the difficulty level so everyone, men and women, can enjoy the story.[/h2][p][/p][h2]Thank you for buying Cat Apocalypse! your support not only helps the development of the game but also to feed stray cats![/h2][p][/p][h2]You are the best for making a positive impact in the world with Cat Apocalypse![/h2][p][/p][h2]God Bless you all![/h2][h2]Chucky Master[/h2][p][/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][/p]

notes.title: Chapter 6 ready!
notes.content:
[h2]In Chapter 6 you will play as Elizabeth, a mysterious Dark elder, daughter of Anika and Alex for those who played Angel Light The Elven Truce.[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45003464/39c5a487512cfc403768d5d34de8cef1783ac3ae.jpg[/img]

[h2]In this Chapter you have to eliminate the Alien demons with all your skills learned through the game!
[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45003464/ae0b47331c303b7af6a917ebe926dd33e988d149.jpg[/img]
[h3]Changes:
*The Electroshock gun has changed from pulse bullets to spread laser bullets
*A Checkpoint has been added in Chapter 5 Alien ship rescue mission, only after you eliminate the alien guard of the first room, by clicking on Checkpoint you are taken to the start position with your soldiers but there is no need to clear the first room of aliens anymore!
*A new Emily video is waiting for you at the Menu screen!
* 5 new achievements! [/h3]

[h2]Thank you for playing CAT APOCALYPSE![/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45003464/4144b3546c435b212ae6528588f55eaed13c17e8.jpg[/img]

[h2]God Bless you all brothers and sisters! VICTORY IS OURS!
JESUS CHRIST RULES!
Chucky Master
Developer[/h2]

[h3]*Special thanks to Emily and Alex for their amazing support and beautiful voice given by God All Mighty*[/h3]

[h2]In God We Trust![/h2]

notes.title: NEW UPDATE INCOMING!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45003464/8bf354bd7a701b81bd283c4df34230b7870db83b.jpg[/img]

[h3]A new update is coming soon! 

Thank you to all the gamers playing the game!

I have seen a lot of people playing Cat Apocalypse, and most of them can beat the demo and the game with a few deaths, but a very small percentage rage quit, because they can not even understand the image of the Hint when you press "Esc" key.

Other minimum players are overwhelmed by the stress and the menace of thinking they are a defenseless cat, and can't handle the ambushes or sudden attacks.

The players that have completed the game and enjoyed it, they all have something in common, which is, they are hardcore players of War like games, shooter games and all type of violent games in general. 

Like Master Bushy right here!
[previewyoutube=8rHZv1LTmaw;full][/previewyoutube]

In order to mentally prepare all the players for what Cat Apocalypse is really about, I'm adding a training Chapter. Is gonna be a piece of cake for veterans but it will help a lot the players that have no idea at all about combat.

Also the first Chapter may change in the future but not the objective.

So thank you again for all your feedback!  Thank you so much for your emails!

Youtubers and content creators I will answer your emails as soon as the update is ready!

Thank you so much to everyone around the globe playing the game! and showing your reaction!

God Bless you all brothers and sisters!
Chucky Master
Developer
My email: angellightgames@gmail.com[/h3]

notes.title: ROBOTS no longer immortal
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45003464/ab4a8cbc30c4b821e9bb9c9a8b6158a35499c249.png[/img]

[h1]Thanks to player gameplay and feedback![/h1]

[h3] I have decided to make the robots no longer immortal.

The demo and Chapter one should be very posible to finish, and I have seen many gameplay videos where the player dies over and over again and rage quits, missing the beautiful love hug waiting for Sam.

The robots are still deadly, and expect harder enemies, in the next chapters, only the demo will be more easy.

Also in the next chapters you may play as the cats owner Jade. You will find out on Octuber 25-26, 2024!

See you soon brothers!

Meow!
God Bless you all!
Chuck Martinez
Developer
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45003464/1a508274643333df20d88c28cf4959c7ec62261f.gif[/img]
[/h3]
